Input Box - Text input field for typing queries

As a Prospect
I navigate to the Nymbus Home Page
I click on the Chatbox input field (2A)
I type a keyword (e.g., 'core', 'modernize', 'digital brand')
I click the submit arrow (2B) or press Enter
Why
column3: Acceptance Criteria

column1: The chatbox expands downward showing a response card (2N) with heading and body text and CTA buttons (2O)
column2: So that the user receives relevant guidance based on their query
column3:
1. Expansion animation: 400ms ease-in-out
2. Response includes heading, body text, and 2-3 CTA buttons
3. Input text remains visible
4. Placeholder changes to 'Ask something else'

column2: As a Prospect with chatbox expanded

Why
column3: Acceptance Criteria

column1: The chatbox collapses with smooth animation and resets to default state
column2: So the user can dismiss the response and start fresh
column3:
1. Collapse animation: 350ms
2. Input text clears
3. Response content removed
4. Placeholder returns to 'What do you want to grow?'
5. Clicking on pills does NOT trigger close
